index.whmcsHelp: Securely provision plans, change packages, suspend accounts and create one-time panel login links from WHMCS.

whmcs.title: Billing with WHMCS
whmcs.subtitle: Backend-only provisioning, lifecycle automation and one-time SSO.
whmcs.step1Help: Add these values to dPanel’s {file}. Use the public outbound IP of the WHMCS server; multiple IPs or CIDRs are comma-separated.
whmcs.oneCommandHelp: Replace the example IP and domain, then copy/paste. Existing keys are updated, missing keys are added, and an existing secret is preserved.
whmcs.editHelp: Edit the IP/domain first, generate a secret, then copy the command. Generating again replaces only the secret in this textarea.
whmcs.sec1: dPanel rejects requests before processing unless the source IP and signed WHMCS domain both match their allowlists.
whmcs.sec2: Every request is HMAC-SHA256 signed with method, path, WHMCS domain, timestamp, nonce and raw-body hash.
whmcs.sec3: Timestamps older than {seconds} seconds and reused nonces are rejected.
whmcs.sec4: SSO URLs expire after {seconds} seconds and are consumed only once. Redirect the browser only to the returned URL.
whmcs.e403: Check WHMCS outbound IP and proxy forwarding.
whmcs.e401: Client ID, shared secret, signature or server clock does not match.
whmcs.e409: Nonce was replayed or the email belongs to another account.
whmcs.e422: The plan slug or required service/customer data is invalid.
